Definition: from G2596 and G5594; to cool down (off), i.e. refresh:--cool.
BiblicalUsage: Send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, for I am tormented in this flame.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the rich man asked for a drop and could not have it, because the time for mercy was past.
